title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:12897:19900103:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Secretariat of the Academy of Arts) <Presidential Decree No. 12897, January 3, 1990>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) Omitted.

(2) The Regulations on Payment of Allowances to Members of the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea and the National Academy of Arts of the Republic of Korea shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2) and (3), "Minister of Education" (former title, 문교부장관) shall be replaced with "Minister of Education or Minister of Culture" (문교부장관 또는 문화부장관).

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Transfer of Authorized Personnel)
Of the authorized personnel of the Secretariat of the Academy of Arts under this Decree, six persons (one Grade IV secretary, one Grade V administrative officer, one Grade VII administrative clerk and three Grade X clerical assistants in technical service) shall be transferred from personnel numbers reduced by the amendment of the Decree on the Organization of the Secretariat of the Academies of Sciences and Arts.
